title: Region pin safelist orchestrator and automated evidence zipper for hosted endpoints
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: Customers require a defensible, machine-readable proof package showing that requests to the Hosted API were pinned to approved regions and retained according to customer-configured retention policies. Current residency controls allow per-tenant region preferences but lack a first-class operator that exposes a safelist workflow, enforcement trace, and a compact evidence bundle for audits.

Goal: Deliver a Region Pin Safelist Orchestrator (operator UI + API) that: (1) allows tenant operators to define a safelist of allowed regions for endpoints; (2) enforces pinning at the routing layer with clear decision traces; and (3) produces a time-bounded, signed evidence bundle ("evidence zipper") that packages routing traces, retention policy snapshots, and configuration provenance for compliance audits.

Scope: Server-side API, Console workflow, evidence export format, backend worker to assemble and sign evidence bundles, telemetry hooks for the Console to display enforcement traces, and RBAC controls. Does not include Private/VPC on-prem installers (handled separately).
notes: 03/01/2026 - Kickoff: Cross-functional sync with runtime, infra, and security. Agreed on layered enforcement: Console->Control Plane validation + Routing-level enforcement in smart router. Action: ENG to prototype routing hook; DES to mock UI flows.

03/05/2026 - Design review: Lena Fischer flagged complexity around multi-tenant display of safelists. Decision: show effective safelist per endpoint with inherited tenant defaults, and allow endpoint-level overrides. Follow-up: DES to create alternate mock showing inheritance collapse.

03/06/2026 - Engineering note (Connor Lee): Initial router hook landed: github.com/redwood-inference/inference/PRs/4187. Prototype emits structured decision events to /telemetry/residency-decision. Need to align schema with evidence zipper spec.

03/09/2026 - Security review kickoff: proposed evidence zipper will be PKCS7-signed by platform key, with optional customer-supplied KMS envelope. Security requested HSM integration doc; ENG to follow up with Security by 03/16.

03/11/2026 - PM decision: evidence zipper format will be newline-delimited JSON manifest + gzipped tar containing CSV traces, endpoint config snapshots, and retention metadata. Size target: <5MB for 30-day window. If larger, provide truncation + index and pointer to long-term archive in tenant vault.
03/12/2026 - UX feedback from Solutions Engineering: add 'preview evidence' in Console using sample bundle generator to help customers validate policies before enabling enforcement.

03/13/2026 - Blocker identified: some legacy endpoints use route aliases that do not surface tenant IDs to the smart router. Dependency created: ENG-27901 to propagate tenant context through legacy gateway. Workaround: soft-enforce mode for affected tenants until gateway fix rolls out.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /v1/residency/safelist returns 200 and persists safelist with schema validation
Console: Endpoint-level safelist editor UI with inheritance toggle and preview
Routing: Smart router emits residency decision events for every request including chosen_region, candidate_regions, reason, and enforcement_mode
Evidence: 'evidence zipper' export that includes signed manifest, routing traces, and retention snapshot generated on-demand and for retention audits
RBAC: Only tenant-admins and platform-compliance roles can generate or download evidence bundles
Telemetry: Dashboard tile showing safelist enforcement rate, soft-fail occurrences, and evidence exports per tenant
qa_plan: Unit tests for safelist schema and validation (backend)
Integration test: create safelist + send routed requests with simulated regions to verify enforcement and decision events
End-to-end: Console create safelist -> router enforces -> evidence export validates signatures and contains correct traces
Performance: validate evidence zipper generation under load (100 concurrent exports) and ensure <30s median generation time for 1-day window
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Evidence bundles may contain sensitive request content. Mitigation: redact request payloads unless tenant has explicit opt-in; include only routing metadata and retention IDs by default.
Risk: Large bundles could impact storage and retrieval performance. Mitigation: limit default window to 30 days and offer pointer to long-term archived snapshot stored in tenant vault.

Risk: Enforcement could cause outages if router mis-classifies regions. Mitigation: rollout plan includes soft-fail (log only) -> staged enforcement -> full enforcement with canary sampling and automatic rollback
next_steps: Finalize evidence zipper spec and signing model with Security (due 2026-03-16)
Design: deliver final UI mocks showing inheritance collapse and preview mode (due 2026-03-20)
Engineering: implement tenant context propagation for legacy gateway (ENG-27901) and complete router hook schema alignment (due 2026-03-28)
Schedule canary rollout: coordinate with SRE and support for initial 5 customers (target week 2026-04-01)
Write initial runbook for customer support to handle evidence export requests and appeals
